t: The Lutec Chimera is a wall-mounted outdoor LED floodlight designed to deliver bright security and task illumination. This single head floodlight is ideal for trade professionals installing lighting on entrances, driveways and outdoor workspaces where extra visibility is needed. The adjustable head produces 1600 lumens of crisp 5000K daylight white light while consuming 13.5W. A built-in PIR sensor detects motion up to 18m away across a 180° area. It features a pre-set dusk-to-dawn mode, 3 selectable time settings of 1, 3 and 10 minutes, and a manual override when constant light is required. The robust IP54 polycarbonate construction ensures lasting performance in wet weather conditions.
b: Manual Override Delivers Constant Light when Required
